---
title: "Testing"
description: "Scan synthetic documents with a test credential to exercise every outcome without spending on verification."
---

A **test credential** is an API application created in test mode. It runs the same SDK and API surface as a live credential, but its scans never reach the DMV, enrichment or billing, are hidden from every dashboard and report, and are deleted after 24 hours.

Under a test credential, scanning one of the synthetic documents below returns that document's canned outcome. Scanning any other document parses normally but still skips vendors and billing. Under a live credential, every test document is rejected as `INTEGRITY_FAKE` with `REASON_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`, so a printed test barcode never passes at a venue.

Every test document belongs to a person whose surname is `TEST` and whose given names spell the scenario, so operators can tell at a glance what they scanned. Print the barcodes at 100% or show them on a second screen; MRZ lines must be printed in the OCR-B typeface to be read by the camera.

## Driver's licenses (PDF417)

| Document | Number | Decision | Reason | Integrity | Of age | Not expired | DLDV | Simulates |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ACCEPT TEST | `T90000001` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | completed | Accepted, no findings. |
| EXPIRED TEST | `T90000002` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_EXPIRED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | false | — | Rejected: the document is past its expiration date. |
| UNDERAGE TEST | `T90000003` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_NOT_OF_AGE` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | false | true | — | Rejected: the holder is below the venue's minimum age. |
| BARCODE VALIDATION FAILED TEST | `T90000004` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_BARCODE_VALIDATION_FAILED` | `INTEGRITY_FAKE` | true | true | — | Rejected: the barcode fails structural validation. |
| AUTHENTICATION FAILED TEST | `T90000005` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` | `INTEGRITY_FAKE` | true | true | — | Rejected: the document fails authentication. |
| VIZ CROSS CHECK FAILED TEST | `T90000006` | `DECISION_VERIFY` | `REASON_VIZ_CROSS_CHECK_FAILED` | `INTEGRITY_POSSIBLY_FAKE` | true | true | — | Needs review: the printed side disagrees with the barcode. |
| MULTI SCAN TEST | `T90000007` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_MULTI_SCAN` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | — | Rejected: the same document was scanned moments ago. |
| PATRON STATUS TEST | `T90000008` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_PATRON_STATUS` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | — | Rejected: the holder is on a venue, organization or network list. |
| MIRAGE TEST | `T90000009` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_MIRAGE` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | — | Rejected: the holder could not have travelled from their previous scan. |
| DMV VERIFIED TEST | `T90000010` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_VERIFIED_REAL` | true | true | completed | Accepted: the issuing DMV confirmed the record. |
| DMV VERIFICATION FAILED TEST | `T90000011` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_DMV_VERIFICATION_FAILED` | `INTEGRITY_VERIFIED_FAKE` | true | true | completed | Rejected: the issuing DMV contradicted the record. |
| DMV PENDING TEST | `T90000012` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | pending | Stays in PROCESSING: the DMV request never returns. |
| DMV UNKNOWN ERROR TEST | `T90000013` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | unknown_error | Accepted, DMV request ended in an unknown error. |
| DMV BALANCE EXHAUSTED TEST | `T90000014` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | balance_exhausted | Accepted, DMV request skipped: balance exhausted. |
| DMV INVALID DOCUMENT TEST | `T90000015` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | invalid_document | Accepted, DMV request skipped: document not eligible. |
| DMV JURISDICTION BLOCKED TEST | `T90000016` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | jurisdiction_blocked | Accepted, DMV request skipped: jurisdiction does not participate. |
| DMV FAILED TEST | `T90000017` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | failed | Accepted, DMV request failed. |
| DMV NOT ENTITLED TEST | `T90000018` | `DECISION_ACCEPT` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_REAL` | true | true | not_entitled | Accepted, DMV request skipped: not entitled. |
| EDUCATION AGE DISCREPANCY TEST | `T90000019` | `DECISION_VERIFY` | `REASON_EDUCATION_AGE_DISCREPANCY` | `INTEGRITY_POSSIBLY_FAKE` | true | true | — | Needs review: education history does not fit the date of birth. |
| CROSS SOURCE DOB DISCREPANCY TEST | `T90000020` | `DECISION_VERIFY` | `REASON_CROSS_SOURCE_DOB_DISCREPANCY` | `INTEGRITY_POSSIBLY_FAKE` | true | true | — | Needs review: another source reports a different date of birth. |
| INTRA IDENTITY DOB DISCREPANCY TEST | `T90000021` | `DECISION_REJECT` | `REASON_INTRA_IDENTITY_DOB_DISCREPANCY` | `INTEGRITY_FAKE` | true | true | — | Rejected: this identity's documents disagree on date of birth. |
| NO RESULT TEST | `T90000022` | `DECISION_UNSPECIFIED` | `REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | `INTEGRITY_UNSPECIFIED` | false | false | — | Processed without a decision. |
